Change the frontAndBack block in constant/polyMesh/boundary to type empty.
Change the frontAndBack block in 0/U to type empty.
Remove any value entry from the frontAndBack block in 0/U because the empty boundary condition does not take a value.
Ensure the frontAndBack patch type in 0/U exactly matches the frontAndBack patch type in constant/polyMesh/boundary.
Leave all other boundary conditions for inlet, outlet, and cylinderWall as already configured.
Run the case with pimpleFoam for a transient, incompressible, laminar simulation.
